George Williams was an absentee and Knifton and Bailey were 'pulled' so, with our team weakened, we were not amongst the medals. Ray Middleton was our first man home in 53.06 with Ray Hall 21st 55.37 and Bob Barnes 56.18,24th, W.
For although they were without Bailey, McGreechan and Yescombe they had three men home before any club could finish two. There was no doubt about this team result!
